ishq: Ishq wo junoon hai jo dil mein utar jaye toh umar bhar nahi bhulta.
Tere ishq ne hamein is qadar badal diya, ki ab khud ki bhi khabar nahi.
Sacha ishq wo hai jisme milna zaroori na ho, bas dil se chahana kaafi ho.
Ishq ki raahon mein thokar khane ka maza hi kuch aur hai.
Hadd-e-ishq se guzre toh pata chala ke dard bhi kitna haseen hota hai.
Tera ishq meri rooh mein is tarah bas gaya hai ke ab sansein bhi teri yaad dilati hain.
Ishq mein jeet aur haar ki parwah kise hoti hai, yahan toh bas chahane ki jeet hoti hai.
Kahin na kahin kuch adhoora sa lagta hai, tere bina ishq poora sa lagta hai.
Jisne ishq ki aag mein jalna sikh liya, use duniya ki kisi aag se darr nahi lagta.
Tere ishq ki khushboo mere dil ke har kone mein mehsoos hoti hai.
Ishq wo dariya hai jiska koi sahara nahi hota, doobne wale ko bas kinara nahi milta.
Na jane kaisa ishq tha tumse, ke har saans mein tumhara hi naam tha.
Ishq ki raahon mein andhera bhi ho toh roshni sirf unki yaad se milti hai.
Jise ishq ho jaye, use fir duniya ki koi khabar nahi rehti.
Teri gali se guzrna bhi ab ishq ki ibadat ban gaya hai.
muhabbat: Muhabbat woh ehsas hai jo bina lafzon ke bhi bayan ho jati hai.
Sachi muhabbat wahi hai jisme koi shart aur koi ummeed na ho.
Tumse muhabbat karna meri zindagi ka sabse khoobsurat faisla tha.
Muhabbat woh taqat hai jo patthar ko bhi mom bana sakti hai.
Jiske dil mein muhabbat ho, use har cheez haseen lagne lagti hai.
Teri muhabbat mein jo sukoon hai, wo duniya ki kisi daulat mein nahi.
Muhabbat wo khazana hai jo bantne se aur zyada barh jata hai.
Sachi muhabbat waqt ke sath purani nahi hoti, balki aur gehri ho jati hai.
Tere naam se shuru hoti hai meri subah, aur teri muhabbat par hoti hai shaam.
Muhabbat sirf paane ka naam nahi, kisi ke liye khud ko badal dena bhi muhabbat hai.
Jis dil mein muhabbat bas jaye, wahan nafrat ke liye jagah nahi rehti.
Tum meri zindagi ki wo muhabbat ho jise khone se bhi darr lagta hai.
Muhabbat ka safar lamba zaroor hota hai, par manzil bohot haseen hoti hai.
Har kisi ke naseeb mein kahan hoti hai aisi sachi muhabbat.
Teri ek jhalak se dil ko jo karar milta hai, wahi asli muhabbat hai.
deewangi: Teri deewangi mein is tarah khoye hain, ki duniya ki ab parwah nahi.
Deewangi ki hadh se guzar kar tujhe chaha hai.
Log kehte hain hum pagal hain, par unhe kya pata deewangi kya hoti hai.
Tere ishq ki deewangi ab sar par charh kar bol rahi hai.
Deewangi mein hosh kahan rehta hai, wahan toh bas ek hi chehra nazar aata hai.
Tujhe dekhne ki deewangi is qadar barh gayi hai ke ab palkein bhi nahi jhapti.
Yeh deewangi nahi toh aur kya hai, ke har khwab mein tera hi naam hota hai.
Apni saari khushiyan tere naam karne ki deewangi hai hum mein.
Deewangi ki raah par chalte chalte ab hum khud ko bhi bhool ge hain.
Tera junoon, teri deewangi hi meri pehchan ban chuki hai.
Pagalpan ki is hadh tak chahte hain tumhe, ke khud ki bhi khabar nahi.
Deewangi ka yeh aalam hai ke har taraf tum hi tum dikhte ho.
Tumse milne ki deewangi ne mujhe jeena sikha diya hai.
Meri deewangi ki misal log ab misalon ke tor par dete hain.
Tera naam sunte hi dil ki dhadkan tez ho jana hi deewangi hai.
dosti: Dosti woh rishta hai jo kismat se nahi, dil se banta hai.
Mushkil waqt mein jo sath nibhaye, wahi sacha dost kahlata hai.
Dosti mein koi rules nahi hote, bas ek doosre ka khayal rakhna hota hai.
Hazar dost milte hain zindagi mein, par kuch hi dil ke qareeb aate hain.
Teri dosti ne mujhe jeene ka ek naya maqsad diya hai.
Dosti ka rishta sabse pakka aur pyaara hota hai.
Sacha dost wo hai jo bina kuch kahe dil ki baat samajh le.
Waqt badal jata hai, log badal jate hain, par sachi dosti kabhi nahi badalti.
Dosti ki raah mein andhera nahi hota, kyunki dosto ka sath ujjala kar deti hai.
Khuda se kya maangu apne liye, jab mujhe tere jaisa dost mil gaya.
Dosti mein roothna manana toh chalta rehta hai, par pyaar kabhi kam nahi hota.
Har mushkil mein jo dhal ban kar khara rahe, wahi dost khas hota hai.
Tujh jaisa dost milna kismat ki baat hoti hai.
Dosti ki misal dene wale bhi hairan hain hamari yaari par.
Zindagi ke har safar mein tera sath sabse bada sahara hai.
pyar: Pyar wo khubsurat tohfa hai jo har kisi ko naseeb nahi hota.
Tere sath bitaya har pal zindagi ka sabse haseen pal hai.
Pyar karne ke liye koi wajah nahi chahiye hoti, bas dil milne chahiye.
Tumse milne ke baad mujhe zindagi se koi aur shiqwa nahi raha.
Pyar mein dooriyan mayne nahi rakhti, agar dil pasand hon.
Tum meri subah ki pehli aur raat ki aakhri soch ho.
Pyar woh roshni hai jo andheri raahon ko bhi roshan kar deti hai.
Dil kehta hai tumhe har khushi de dun, yahi toh sacha pyar hai.
Tere chehre ki muskurahat se meri duniya roshan ho jati hai.
Pyar ka ehsas hi kuch aisa hota hai ke har taraf khushiyan hi khushiyan nazar aati hain.
Tumse pyar karna meri roshni aur meri taqat ban gaya hai.
Zindagi ke har mod par mujhe tera hi pyar chahiye.
Pyar wo ehsas hai jo lafzon mein bayan nahi kiya ja sakta.
Tumhe paakar aisa laga jaise mujhe puri kainaat mil gayi ho.
Dil ki har dhadkan sirf tumhara hi naam leti hai.
dard: Dard chhupanay ki aadat ne humein muskurana sikha diya.
Kuch zakhm aisy hotay hain jo waqt ke sath bhi nahi bharte.
Apno se mile dard ko lafzon mein bayan karna mushkil hota hai.
Khamoshi bhi ek dard hai jo sirf wahi samajh sakta hai jo akela ho.
Muskurahat ke peeche chhupa dard har koi nahi dekh pata.
Dard jab hadh se barh jata hai toh hansi mein badal jata hai.
Aansu wo zuban hain jo dard ko bina bole sab kuch keh dete hain.
Kismat ka khel bhi ajeeb hai, jise chaha usi ne sabse bada dard diya.
Raat ki tanhai mein dard aur bhi zyada gehra ho jata hai.
Har dard ek sabak deta hai, aur wahi insaan ko mazboot banata hai.
Zakhm kitne bhi purane hon, unki kasak hamesha baaki rehti hai.
Apnon ke diye hue dard ki koi dawa nahi hoti.
Tanha raahon mein dard hi mera sabse qareeb dost ban gaya hai.
Dil ke kisi kone mein aaj bhi ek dard chhipa baitha hai.
Rona chahte hain par aansu bhi jaise bewafa ho gaye hon.
dillagi: Dillagi mein dil kab de bethe, pata hi nahi chala.
Teri har adaa par dillagi karne ko dil chahta hai.
Pyar se pehle ki shuruwat aksar dillagi se hi होती hai.
Teri baaton se dillagi karna ab meri aadat ban gayi hai.
Dillagi mein aksar dil hi haar jate hain log.
Thori si dillagi ne is dil ko tera deewana bana diya.
Tumse dillagi karke ye ehsas hua ke zindagi kitni haseen hai.
Muskurate hue tumse dillagi karna mujhe sabse accha lagta hai.
Dillagi ka yeh silsila yunhi umar bhar chalta rahe.
Dil ki baat zuban par laane ka yeh sabse pyara tareeqa hai.
Teri har hansi par dillagi karne ka maza hi alag hai.
Dillagi se shuru hui thi kahani aur ab pyar ban gayi hai.
Tumse thori si dillagi kya ki, tumne toh dil hi chura liya.
Aisi dillagi kisi aur ke sath kahan mumkin hai.
Hamesha yunhi muskura kar humse dillagi karte rehna.
